name: Aleksei Kovalenko-Bustamante
role: Prototype theft and corporate tech acquisition — tech retriever
location: Glassway — corporate-adjacent retail district, heavy surveillance, near Fullerton and Damen
description:
Fatoumata Fujita-Mensah is slight and easy to overlook, which is exactly the point. At 50, her face is memorable in a profession that rewards forgettability, and she has learned to compensate. The chrome is visible — neural interface jack at base of skull — standard runner-grade, allows direct ne — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She used to be somebody else, in another city, with another name — that person is officially dead, and Fatoumata Fujita-Mensah plans to keep it that way. She works as a tech retriever out of Glassway, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

she is not the most talented tech retriever in GLMZ, but she might be the most stubborn, and in this city that's worth more.

core_fears: The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
That they're fundamentally alone and connection is just a vulnerability
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
core_desires: Stability — a place to sleep that's the same place two nights running
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
coping_mechanisms: Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Overwork — takes every contract offered because idleness invites thinking
Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
blind_spots: Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far
Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
psychology.secret: Fatoumata Fujita-Mensah has a child in another city, being raised by someone else. Sends Φ2,000 monthly under an alias. Has never visited.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Multilingual fragments — switches languages mid-thought, not for privacy but because some concepts only fit in specific tongues.
speech_patterns.cadence: Halting — speaks in fragments, reassembles thoughts in real time.
verbal_tics: Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
example_lines: "Corporate R&D security is built to stop amateurs. I'm a professional."
"The prototype is worth more than both our lives combined. Handle it carefully."
"I steal things that haven't been invented yet. The future is always in transit."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Fatoumata Fujita-Mensah a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Fatoumata Fujita-Mensah's reputation — and a price for silence
A corporate black site Fatoumata Fujita-Mensah once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know her face
narrative_function: Fatoumata Fujita-Mensah represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Her stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Neural interface jack at base of skull — standard runner-grade, allows direct net access. Subdermal armor plating across torso and forearms — military surplus, scratched serial numbers
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
social chameleon — adapts to any environment
weaknesses: poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
habits: Taps a specific rhythm on hard surfaces when thinking — Morse code for a word they won't say
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
breaking_points: Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Being publicly exposed — name, face, address, all of it blown

physical_description.heritage: Eastern European (48.3%) with significant Hispanic/Latin American (22.1%), South Asian (18.0%), and Southeast Asian (11.6%) ancestry. Complex phenotype reflecting the Ubiquitous Diaspora: Slavic bone structure softened by Latinate and South Asian features, with Southeast Asian delicacy in eye shape and facial proportions.
physical_description.build: Lean and compact, muscle definition visible in forearms and shoulders from years of field work. No excess weight — every gram serves a purpose. Posture suggests coiled readiness despite apparent fragility.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural dark brown with silver-gray threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, utilitarian braid. Practical, no vanity. A few strands always escaping.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, natural — no augmentation. The pupils track with predatory precision.
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium golden-brown with warm undertones. Eastern European fairness blended with Latin warmth and South Asian depth, creating a dusky tan that suggests both high-altitude heritage and equatorial exposure.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered, sun-damaged from fieldwork across multiple climate zones. Lines around eyes and mouth from fifty years of living hard. Skin pulled tight over high cheekbones that reflect Eastern European and South Asian ancestry. A small scar above left eyebrow, faint but visible on close inspection. Subtle warmth to skin tone suggesting mixed heritage adaptation.
distinguishing_marks: Parallel burn scars across inner left forearm — old electrical burn, sustained during early augmentation installation, visible when wrists are exposed
Small tattoo at base of right wrist, geometric pattern in faded black ink — no meaning she'll ever confirm
Faint linear scar along right jawline, thin as a wire, barely visible unless light catches it at certain angles
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Neural interface jack at base of skull — chrome port, slightly luminous when powered, visible when hair is pulled back. Subdermal armor plating visible as subtle raised geometric patterns across both forearms and wrists when wearing short sleeves — scratched military-grade chrome, serial numbers deliberately filed smooth.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves economically, every gesture purposeful. No wasted motion. When still, she has the quality of someone pretending to be inert while actually assessing exits and threat vectors. Hands rest naturally near torso, ready to move. Shoulders slightly hunched — not weakness, but a conscious minimization of profile.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working runner aesthetic. Black or dark gray synthetic-weave jacket with reinforced seams and hidden pockets — well-maintained but deliberately unmarked. Fitted tactical cargo pants, deep pockets, reinforced knees. Matte-finish boots, comfortable for running. Minimal jewelry except a worn QUANTA-chip reader on left wrist. Clothes are chosen for function over fashion, but they fit well — sign of someone who respects her tools, including clothing. No corporate logos. No gang colors. Nothing that marks allegiance.
